Records show developer Stronghold previously donated to former Mayor Steven Hernandez. May 11, 2026: heated town hall at the Boys & Girls Club drew dozens of frustrated residents directly confronting Stronghold Power Systems; a moratorium petition circulated, and the project was required to complete a full EIR before approval.
